goal: Protect nodes from worst-case memory allocations triggered by invalid peer blocks and transactions
Reject impossible transactions early during network deserialization to bound memory use
agreement: Strong support with no open objections (maflcko, Yudis-bit, l0rinc)
Support for dropping complex stream state tracking in favor of the simpler checks (l0rinc, Yudis-bit)
Open suggestions on test coverage, boundary margins, and release notes await author reply (l0rinc)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents peers from forcing nodes into large memory allocations with bogus messages
Malicious peers can no longer fill blocks with hundreds of thousands of empty transactions to exhaust RAM

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it caps pre-validation allocation sizes for inputs and outputs to physical block limits
Avoids repeated multi-megabyte reallocations for transactions that could never be consensus-valid
